title: Paper reproductions
description: Reproductions of published physics-ML papers: targets quoted and frozen in TARGETS.md before any run, measured with the neutral evaluator (pinneapple_analysis.reproduction). One folder per paper. Biology: BINNs (Lagergren et al. 2020) and SBINN (Daneker et al. 2022).

metrics.name: binns_fkpp_gls_10000
metrics.how: classical FKPP fitted by L-BFGS-B from 9 neutral starts (paper Table 2: 786.80)

metrics.name: binns_fkpp_targets_reproduced
metrics.how: GLS and D, r within the factor-2 band of reproduction.status, all six densities

metrics.name: binns_porous_fkpp_targets_reproduced
metrics.how: GLS and D, m, r within the factor-2 band of reproduction.status; 18,000 partial (D, m outside); at 16,000 and 18,000 our GLS is 5.9 % and 9.4 % below the paper's

metrics.name: binns_delay_model_gls_10000
metrics.how: reduced-scale (16 of 64 starts, 1 of 6 data sets): BINN-guided delay model fitted from neutral starts (paper Table 2: 557.01); not reproduced

metrics.name: binns_binn_forward_gls_10000
metrics.how: reduced-scale (1 of 20 retrains, 2000 of 20000 iterations): forward GLS of the learned D, G, T terms; T stays flat at 0.58

metrics.name: sbinn_scaled_median_param_rel_error
metrics.how: reduced-scale (100k of 610k epochs), scaled losses, seed 0: median over 17 parameters of |inferred/true - 1|

metrics.name: sbinn_scaled_forecast_rel_l2
metrics.how: G with the inferred parameters vs the true model on [1800, 3000] min (meal at 2000 min)

metrics.name: sbinn_raw_median_param_rel_error
metrics.how: reduced-scale (100k of 610k epochs), raw losses, seed 0: median over 17 parameters of |inferred/true - 1|

metrics.name: sbinn_raw_forecast_rel_l2
metrics.how: G with the inferred parameters vs the true model on [1800, 3000] min (meal at 2000 min)

metrics.name: icenode_sse_500s_no_kinetics
metrics.how: sum of squared m/m0 errors over 286 chamber series, t<500 s (paper Table 1: 41396)

metrics.name: icenode_sse_500s_nelson_baker
metrics.how: same loss with the Nelson & Baker (1996) deposition coefficient (paper: 40751)

metrics.name: icenode_sse_500s_strong_node
metrics.how: strongly-constrained NODE, alpha = f(S_i, T), 500 epochs (paper: 30714)

metrics.name: icenode_sse_500s_weak_node
metrics.how: weakly-constrained NODE, G/Gc = f(S_i, T, m), 500 epochs (paper: 16495)

metrics.name: icenode_synthetic_alpha_median_rel_error
metrics.how: median |alpha_NN/alpha_NB - 1| with the strong NODE trained on synthetic series of known alpha

metrics.name: icenode_symbolic_rmse_ratio
metrics.how: RMSE of the discovered closed form for G/Gc against the trained network (target spread 0.2033)

references: Jin et al. J Theor Biol 2016
Lagergren et al. PLoS Comput Biol 2020 (arXiv:2005.13073)
